history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration take systematic remedial action on the critical risk findings to mitigate the risks and improve the performance of funds in accordance with the revised operational handbook.
history.administration_response: The revised guidelines on country-based pooled funds have addressed this concern and provided guidance on how the follow- up of critical findings should be conducted by the Humanitarian Financing Units, and on what happens when partners do not comply with the agreed-upon corrective action. Training for the Humanitarian Financing Units on how to implement the guidelines and manage critical findings has also been rolled out. The Units follow up on specific critical audit findings during the implementation of subsequent projects approved for the same partner. A proper audit recommendation follow-up plan is requested from partners and reviewed by Humanitarian Financing Units during field visits and financial spot checks. In addition, these high-risk findings are also shared with external audit firms to ensure that previous recommendations have been implemented. An audit report with high-risk findings directly affects the partner risk level.
history.board_assessment: Given that the guidelines on country-based pooled funds have been revised to address follow-up action on critical risk findings, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
